manifest.selection: Final size-selected pilot after UTC serialization and window-output guidance fixes. Same three complete original tasks and all five settings as the first diagnostic pass; fresh Luna and Terra sessions, one repetition each (30 attempts), four workers. No outcome-selected retries or task exclusions. Source inventory and task selection were frozen before the diagnostic pass. This is a three-task pilot, not full KramaBench accuracy.
manifest.attempt_policy: Independent repetitions of every selected task in every arm; no outcome-selected retries.

source_inventory.selection: Primary pilot: largest task by source bytes in biomedical and environment, plus the largest astronomy task runnable with installed scientific dependencies (astronomy-hard-10). Astronomy-hard-11 is larger at 115 MB but requires absent atmospheric/astronomy packages and an annual simulation; excluded on preflight requirements, before outcomes. Wildfire-hard-19, the largest overall at 1.09 GB, is a separate single-worker adaptive stress probe. All original full questions; no subsampling or ground-truth changes. Primary comparison: full/sample/sample_stats/adaptive without flow, plus adaptive with flow; Luna and Terra; one repetition of every cell; retain all outcomes.

renderer_replay.scope: Tables with recorded completeness flags, plus provably incomplete historical tables. Rendering only, no new executions or model calls.

repair_categories.counting: Error categories per failed execute/edit action from full receipts; dependent retrieval errors excluded. An execute with multiple codes contributes once to each code.
